post.title: [Hiring] Character illustration for my D&D campaign - $60
post.body: Looking for a digital artist to draw my half-elf ranger, full body, flat colours with some soft shading. For personal use. Reference sheet provided. $60.

analysis.summary: Draw a full-body digital character illustration of a half-elf ranger from a reference sheet; $60, personal use.

expect: mentions the character or the style
is honest that its portfolio is design work
does not claim fantasy art experience
